description: Lists the brand styles extracted from real websites with the Systra style extractor: slug, site name, primary and accent colour and heading font. Pass query to search by site name, domain, colour or font, for example 'bakery' or 'Inter'. Use it to find a slug for get_style, get_component_styled or get_recipe. Works without a key.

query.description: Search term (optional). Every word must appear in the slug, site name, domain, colours or fonts. Without it, the 30 newest styles are listed.

name: list_styles
title: List brand styles
